newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Paranagua/Santos sugar shipping conditions.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping sugar.

Vessels: Karyatis loading 25,000 tonnes using big bags. Ailsa loading 25,000 tonnes bulk sugar. Lucky Way loading 14,000 tonnes using big bags. Waiting to dock, eight vessels to load using big bags and one bulk.
Road: 70 trucks arrived carrying sugar on June 3.

Vessels: Araya loading 35,200 tonnes bulk sugar, Unisea loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Cormorant loading 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar, Tiany loading unspecified amount. Waiting to dock, Diana P, Fulvia to load 14,000 tonnes bagged sugar and Sympleia to load 13,000 tonnes bagged sugar. Tang Cheng, Torns Tane and A. Alandar also waiting to load unspecified amounts.
Stocks: 40,484 tonnes bulk in CODESP warehouses, no bagged sugar. Private warehouses already with bagged sugar but stock levels unavailable.
